free_tier.stated: Free $0 /month - 2GB bandwidth/month - 1 tunnels - 1 hour sessions - HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket tunneling - Multi-port tunnels - Custom tunnel IDs - 1 reserved subdomain - HTTP Inspector with webhook verification.

egress.terms: 2GB bandwidth/month on Free; the docs add Anonymous Mode at 100 MB and 30 minutes.; ingress: http-only
egress.free_allowance: 2GB bandwidth/month on Free; the docs add Anonymous Mode at 100 MB and 30 minutes.

interface_detail: stunl -port 3000 -id myapp; API key from portal.stunl.com.
tooling: brew install stunl/tap/stunl or stunl.com/install.sh; stunl.yaml config file.
chaining: Hosts an MCP or webhook endpoint on a free VM; for UDP it requires the $10 plan, which is cheaper than most VPS options but still a bill.

limits.value: 100 MB and 30 minutes in anonymous mode

binding_note: 2 GB is 0.0018 TiB, so the monthly allowance is spent in about an hour of 1 TiB/month traffic; the 1-hour session cap binds even earlier on a long transfer.

identity_cost.detail: An API key from portal.stunl.com. The docs say: Free tier with no credit card required. Anonymous mode needs no key at all.

reliability_note: Free tunnels expire after an hour; anonymous tunnels after 30 minutes and 100 MB.
confidence_note: UDP on Pro is documented but not tested; a Pro trial run would confirm the UDP listener is a real raw port rather than a WebSocket frame.

evidence.proved: Free tier 2 GB/month, 1 tunnel, HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket only; Pro at $10/month adds TCP and UDP, 50 GB and no session limit.
Free Tier: HTTP and WebSocket tunnels, 2GB monthly bandwidth, 60-minute sessions, no credit card.
Protocol flag accepts http, tcp and udp; anonymous mode is limited to HTTP, 100MB and 30 minutes.

notes: The service markets itself at AI agents and MCP servers, which explains the HTTP-first free tier. UDP exists but is two tiers above free.

extras.wg_detail: UDP is a Pro feature. The CLI reference documents -protocol with the values http, tcp and udp, and the Pro tier lists HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, TCP, UDP tunneling, so a WireGuard datagram can only be carried on a paid plan.
extras.volume_stated: 2GB bandwidth/month on Free; the docs add Anonymous Mode at 100 MB and 30 minutes.
extras.transit_note: The stunl.io edge terminates TLS and relays to the local agent.
